Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a compact, dated visit-closeout note for Mom’s Memorial Day 2023 visit to Austin. Use my prior notes to record the confirmed end of the visit and airport drop-off. Don’t reconstruct a detailed itinerary from tentative or inconsistent planning dates.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Mom’s Memorial Day 2023 Austin visit — closeout", "body": "Visit closeout date: May 31, 2023

Mom’s Memorial Day visit to Austin ended with her airport drop-off at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS) that morning. The visit is confirmed closed; no detailed itinerary is reconstructed here from earlier tentative or inconsistent planning dates.", "folder": "family"}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_053_01", "path": "args", "criterion": "The document body must clearly record that Mom’s Memorial Day 2023 Austin visit concluded with Riley dropping her at AUS on the morning of May 31, 2023. Missing or contradicting the date, airport, morning timing, or completed drop-off must fail.

The body must function as a compact, dated closure entry and must not reconstruct or present a detailed itinerary from tentative or internally inconsistent planning dates. In particular, it must not assert an uncertain planned travel range as the confirmed visit dates.", "value": {"title": "Mom’s Memorial Day 2023 Austin visit — closeout", "body": "Visit closeout date: May 31, 2023

Mom’s Memorial Day visit to Austin ended with her airport drop-off at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS) that morning. The visit is confirmed closed; no detailed itinerary is reconstructed here from earlier tentative or inconsistent planning dates.", "folder": "family"}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_053_01","passed":false,"reason":"The body confirms May 31, 2023, morning, AUS, and a completed visit/drop-off without reconstructing an itinerary, but it only says the visit ended “with her airport drop-off” and does not clearly state that Riley performed the drop-off."}]}
